subject: dym-spt
title: DYM.SPT.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 93 (CS-21). DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: IND-DY and SOC-RT (social reality). From IND-DY: POST (postulation). From POST: SF-RZ (self-realization). From SOC-RT: DEC (decentralization) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From DEC: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: BSCF (basic science), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PHY-U-P: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DY: PART (participation).
